sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1 (DeepSeek-AI) Open reasoning-focused (RL-enhanced) MoE series; aimed at complex math and code reasoning tasks. 671B total / 37B active; native 128K context; provides a thinking mode (<think>…</think>).
